stories.title: Suspected plague death at Russian lab prompts U.S. and EU monitoring
new_facts: Russia says lab worker died of 'pneumonia of unknown origin,' denying plague exposure link.
Rubio says US is monitoring a possible plague outbreak in Russia.
189 people placed under medical observation in Irkutsk.
Consumer watchdog confirms only pneumonia at 'anti-plague institute'; rumors suggest worse.
Names victim Darya Shipilova, 28, reportedly after dropping a vial of live plague bacterium.
European Commission spokesperson says EU is closely monitoring the suspected plague case.
Shelekhovsky district mayor Maxim Modin announces 'comprehensive' anti-epidemic measures; names institute.
stories.line: A lab worker in Russia possibly died of plague; U.S. and EU are monitoring while Russia downplays the case.

stories.title: Utah launches AI-only acne diagnosis and prescription pilot
stories.line: Utah is piloting AI systems to diagnose acne and prescribe medications without a doctor's direct involvement, a first in the U.S.

stories.title: Altman says world must accept AI harms for its gains
new_facts: OpenAI publicist filmed trying to deflect Vanity Fair question to Altman about a ChatGPT-linked suicide
Cerebras stock rose 9% after Altman called it a 'close partner'
Altman says world should 'accept bad things' from AI; mentions a safety expert's resignation
Vanity Fair Q&A covers Altman on Trump, midterms, AI extinction risk, Xi Jinping visit, Brockman's donations
Vanity Fair Q&A covers Altman's kids, rivalries, pronatalism, prepping, IPO delay, and Guadagnino's 'Artificial'
Altman tells POLITICO's Bordelon 'something's clearly not working' on AI money in midterms; repeats 'accept bad things' line
stories.line: Sam Altman tells Vanity Fair that societies must accept harms from AI to get its benefits; a ChatGPT PR person tried to stop the interview.

stories.title: NHL's all-time leading goalscorer Ovechkin to retire after this season
new_facts: Ovechkin announces retirement at season's end; led Capitals to first Stanley Cup; turned 41 in September
Specifies 2026-2027 season as his final year; 22 seasons all with Capitals
Direct quote from Ovechkin on X; one-year contract; broke Gretzky's record in April 2025
stories.line: Alex Ovechkin, NHL's all-time leading goalscorer, announces he will retire after this season.

stories.title: Saudi-backed forces launch major offensive against Houthis in Yemen
new_facts: Reveals internal Pentagon hawk/dove debates before Iran war, naming Gen. Michael 'Erik' Kurilla as key hawkish voice.
New number: Brent crude hovering around $100/barrel amid Houthi battle for Red Sea shipping lanes.
Saudi and Yemeni government forces launch offensive to retake Red Sea coast and Bab al-Mandab Strait from Houthis.
Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claim recapture of Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which handles ~12% of global trade, seized by Houthis last month.
New number: 100 Saudi warplanes conducted dawn strikes supporting Yemeni government offensive against Houthis.
Yemeni government forces reportedly aim to push toward Sanaa as part of the offensive, though full Houthi defeat seen as challenging.
Yemeni President Rashad al-Alimi announces offensive, vowing to fight 'until the country is liberated' from Houthi rule.
stories.line: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces launched a major offensive against Iran-backed Houthis controlling the Red Sea strait, risking a new escalation in Yemen's long conflict.

stories.title: Leaked audio: Paxton says Trump's team controls his Senate campaign
new_facts: Paxton privately admitted Washington, not him, is driving his Senate campaign's messaging.
The Bulwark published the actual leaked audio/video recording of Paxton's remarks.
Names Democratic rival James Talarico and quotes Paxton: 'I don't control message or what we're doing.'
Paxton's office is investigating Texas pediatricians over childhood vaccinations, alleging a profit-driven conspiracy.
Fuller quote: 'I've never been in a race where I felt less control...it's all coming from D.C.'; recording shared with Politico.
stories.line: Leaked audio shows Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton saying his Senate campaign is controlled by Trump's Washington team, not by him.

stories.title: Bolsonaro leads Brazil's presidential race after first round
new_facts: New story: Flávio Bolsonaro's first-round lead over Lula sets up a three-week runoff battle in Brazil's election.
Gives exact first-round vote totals: Bolsonaro 56.1m (47.03%) vs Lula 53.8m (45.16%); candidates' ages 45 and 80.
Brazilian stocks jumped on the result; runoff set for October 25.
Trump administration actively backing Bolsonaro as part of a broader push for conservative allies across Latin America, including Colombia and Argentina.
Adds on-record analysis from Felipe Krause, head of Oxford's Brazilian Studies Programme, on polarization and Bolsonaro's appeal.
Adds analysis from researcher Thomas Zicman de Barros noting this is historically unprecedented for a first-round trailing candidate.
stories.line: Flávio Bolsonaro leads Brazil's presidential race after first-round voting, positioning the right-wing candidate to likely defeat incumbent Lula in a runoff.

stories.title: Trump promises senior payments and diesel relief before midterms
new_facts: Trump plans executive order to lower high diesel costs ahead of midterms.
Trump pledges ~$100 direct deposits to 20 million Medicare seniors; legality questioned.
Trump reiterates $5,000 check pledge tied to GOP keeping Congress; notes $500 ACA refunds alongside $90 Medicare rebates.
New NBC poll shows GOP facing uphill battle; taxpayer-funded Trump ads airing during prime-time football broadcasts.
stories.line: Trump promises cash payments to seniors and pledges diesel cost relief ahead of midterm elections, raising questions about legal authority.

stories.title: Prince Andrew sues police over Epstein-related arrest warrants
new_facts: King Charles will not use private funds to finance Andrew's legal action against Thames Valley Police.
Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor is suing Thames Valley Police over search warrants used in his February arrest.
Police searched Andrew's homes at Sandringham estate and Royal Lodge, Windsor, on his 66th birthday.
stories.line: Prince Andrew is suing Thames Valley Police over arrest warrants related to Epstein files; King Charles reportedly won't pay his legal costs.

Employees had feared Bari Weiss might replace Thompson; additional memo quote on CNN integration
stories.line: Skydance's new owner, a Trump ally, may be slowing Colbert's Lord of the Rings film after canceling his late-night show.
